title: Encyclopedia, profiles and items
summary: Browse the running world, look at a player, and give or take items.

sections.heading: The Encyclopedia
steps: Start the server. The Encyclopedia reads the world by itself once the server answers.
Pick Heroes and lords, Clans, Kingdoms, Settlements, Troops or Items on the left.
Search by name, or use the chips above the list to show one kind or one kingdom.
Click a name on a card to follow it, and press Back to go back.
Lords move and towns change hands while you play. Press Read again for the newest world.
sections.tip: Nothing in the Encyclopedia changes the game. Pictures come from Build pictures on the Cheats page.

sections.heading: Player profile
steps: Press Profile next to a player on the Players page, or Open profile on the Cheats page.
The profile shows level, gold, health, influence, renown and army.
The tabs are Skills, Equipment, Inventory and Army. Press the refresh icon to read it again.
On Skills you can change skill levels, focus points, attribute points and XP.
At the bottom are Open in Cheats, Give/take items, Show on map and Ban.

sections.heading: The Items window
steps: Open it with Open items on the Cheats page, or Give/take items in a profile.
Pick Give items or Take items. Take items works on one player at a time.
Click items to put them in the basket, then press the Give or Take button under it.
Give value as gold gives the basket's value as gold instead of the items.
On an item in the Encyclopedia, Give with the Items window opens it with that item searched.
sections.tip: The window says what the server confirmed. An item the server refused stays in the basket.
